title: Water at the soil surface: runoff and evaporation
intro: temperature change rate [h-1 ]: Relative change of surface temperature. If you set this to a negative value, surface temperature will reflect temperature of incomming water or ponded; EpFactor [dimensionless]: The autumn value can be lower, due to muching. With a crop factor of 1.2 a combined Kc of 1.15 is reached at LAI=5. See also [Kjaersgaard et al., 2008]; ReservoirConstant [h-1 ]: Fraction of ponding above DetentionCapacity that runoffs each hour. Each is varied from half to double the value the farm uses; temperature change rate, EpFactor, ReservoirConstant moved the yield, water or nitrogen in the test.
